name: swarm-substrate
description: Reference implementation of the trust substrate underneath multi-agent swarm orchestration: integrity-checked inputs, PQ-signed provenance, Byzantine quorum consensus, out-of-band kill-switch enforcement, and independent adversarial verification, composed and running end to end.
author: Ahmed Hassan (A2Z SOC)

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/schema.test.js dist/tests/integrity.test.js dist/tests/consensus.test.js dist/tests/killswitch.test.js dist/tests/provenance.test.js dist/tests/swarm.e2e.test.js
